newsitem.title: USA: Dow surges 30 points early after setting milestone.
newsitem.headline: Dow surges 30 points early after setting milestone.

text.p: The Dow industrials on Tuesday surged 30 points or 0.51 percent to 6041 within minutes of the opening bell, a day after the blue chip index ended above 6000 for the first time in history.

Solid quarterly earnings reports from Intel, up 5-1/8 to 113-5/8, and Chrysler, up 1-1/8 to 33-7/8, among others, helped fuel buying. Also helping equities was modest strength in the bond market, with the long bond up 5/32 to yield 6.83 percent.
The Nasdaq Composite soared 12 to 1268, also making further inroads into record territory.
